title: Ootle WASM Templates
creator: Tari project
summary: Official Rust/WASM starting points for games, tokens, NFTs, swaps and counters. The November 2, 2026 update uses tari_template_lib 0.37, test tooling 0.49 and template build 0.17.1. The guessing-game CLI uses ootle-rs 0.31. Stablecoin tests now authorize a proof explicitly before withdrawal. The recording shows the merged dependency-update discussion, not template execution. Earlier guide footage and sharing posts remain in the maintenance history.
publicationBasis: GitHub repository creation date; this is not a claim about the first release date.
